hunks.baseline: “Ah, fuck. This is fucking bullshit, seriously.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, fuck. This is fucking bullshit.”

hunks.baseline: *Who was he?* He was the Roaring Fury Swordsman, Song Il. Even now that his junior brother, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, had become Sect Leader, he still treated Song Il with the utmost courtesy and respect.
hunks.sol: *Who was he?* He was Song Il, the Roaring Fury Swordsman. Even now that his junior brother, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, had become Sect Leader, he still treated Song Il with the utmost courtesy and respect.

hunks.baseline: And yet—what the fuck? This is fucking bullshit?
hunks.sol: And yet—what the fuck? Fucking bullshit?

hunks.baseline: A brat who had only just turned twenty with the change of the year.
hunks.sol: A brat who had only just turned twenty with the new year.

hunks.baseline: “It’s fucking bullshit. I said it’s fucking bullshit! You fucking assholes! There’s a limit to how much you can throw your weight around.”
hunks.sol: “It’s fucking bullshit. I said it’s fucking bullshit. You fucking assholes. There’s a limit to how much you can throw your weight around.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry. I know this is something I’m supposed to put up with even if it’s fucking bullshit, but they were being so fucking shitty about it that it became twice as fucking shitty, and I couldn’t let it slide.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry. I know I’m supposed to put up with it even when it’s fucking bullshit, but they were being so fucking shitty about it that it felt twice as fucking shitty, and I couldn’t let it slide.”

hunks.baseline: “To be honest, I thought it was fucking bullshit too.”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, I thought it was fucking bullshit too.”

hunks.baseline: The disbelief in Song Il’s eyes slowly gave way to light. A blazing light.
hunks.sol: The disbelief in Song Il’s eyes slowly gave way to a blazing light.

hunks.baseline: Hot breath escaped between Song Il’s teeth as he lost control of himself.
hunks.sol: Hot breath escaped between Song Il’s teeth as he lost all reason.

hunks.baseline: Shing.
hunks.sol: *Shing.*

hunks.baseline: Although he had not achieved complete mastery, it was more than enough to turn these insolent fools into minced meat with a single sword strike.
hunks.sol: Although he had not achieved Great Completion, it was more than enough to carve these insolent fools into chunks of meat with a single sword strike.

hunks.baseline: And just as Song Il was about to shoot his Sword Energy with bloodshot eyes—
hunks.sol: Just as Song Il was about to unleash his Sword Energy, his eyes bloodshot—

hunks.baseline: At the voice that came from somewhere, Song Il’s body abruptly froze.
hunks.sol: At the voice from somewhere nearby, Song Il’s body abruptly froze.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t because of the meaning behind those words. He couldn’t determine where they had come from at all.
hunks.sol: Not because of what the words meant. Because he couldn’t determine where they had come from.

hunks.baseline: But the voice that followed made it clear that this situation was real.
hunks.sol: But the voice that followed made it clear that this was real.

hunks.baseline: “A man your age, picking on a child like this. Tsk, tsk.”
hunks.sol: “A man your age, picking on a child. What a disgrace. Tsk, tsk.”

hunks.baseline: At last, Song Il realized the identity of the voice, and his body trembled.
hunks.sol: When Song Il finally realized what he was hearing, his body began to tremble.

hunks.baseline: If Sound Transmission, the art of transmitting sound through internal energy, was exclusive to Peak masters, Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission was a martial art permitted only to those who had reached the realm beyond it.
hunks.sol: If Sound Transmission, the art of conveying sound through internal energy, was the exclusive province of Peak masters, Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission was a martial art permitted only to those who had reached the realm beyond it.

hunks.baseline: The Supreme Peak. A great realm that only a tiny fraction of the chosen few could enter.
hunks.sol: Supreme Peak. A great realm that only a tiny fraction of the chosen few could enter.

hunks.baseline: Song Il shouted as though having a fit.
hunks.sol: Song Il shouted as if having a fit.

hunks.baseline: “Who are you! I am Elder Song Il of the Great Zhongnan Sect, the Roaring Fury Swordsman! Show yourself at once!”
hunks.sol: “Who are you? I am Elder Song Il of the Great Zhongnan Sect, the Roaring Fury Swordsman! Show yourself at once!”

hunks.baseline: Thunderous laughter rang out from every direction. The internal energy behind it was so vast that no one dared guess at its limits.
hunks.sol: Thunderous laughter rang out from every direction, backed by internal energy so vast that no one dared guess at its limits.

hunks.baseline: “Can you not hear me!”
hunks.sol: “Can you not hear me?”

hunks.baseline: “You insolent—!”
hunks.sol: “You insolent bastard!”

hunks.baseline: Song Il had lost his composure to anger and fear. And in his eyes, he saw Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Having lost his composure to anger and fear, Song Il caught sight of Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the people staring around in shock, Jin Taekyung alone was gazing into the empty air. There was even an enigmatic smile on his lips.
hunks.sol: Unlike everyone else, who was staring around in shock, Jin Taekyung alone gazed into the empty air with an enigmatic smile on his lips.

hunks.baseline: Ssssss!
hunks.sol: *Ssssss!*

hunks.baseline: He didn’t know where the voice’s owner was, but the troublemaker’s weakness was Jin Taekyung. The fluster in the other man’s voice was proof.
hunks.sol: He didn’t know who the meddler was or where he was hiding, but his weakness was Jin Taekyung. The alarm in the other man’s voice proved it.

hunks.baseline: “Heh, look at you. You’ve grown even more venomous since I last saw you.”
hunks.sol: “Heh, look at you. You’ve grown even more vicious since I last saw you.”

hunks.baseline: Song Il flinched as he thought of someone, but quickly gritted his teeth.
hunks.sol: Song Il flinched as someone came to mind, but quickly gritted his teeth.

hunks.baseline: “Phew. Fine, I understand. I’ll come out now, so wait right there! But if you touch even a single hair on him, I’ll make you pay for it!”
hunks.sol: “Phew. Fine, I understand. I’ll come out now, so wait right there! But if you touch even a single hair on him, I’ll make you pay!”

hunks.baseline: Song Il’s strength left him all at once.
hunks.sol: The tension drained from Song Il’s body.

hunks.baseline: “Fifty jang. Don’t come within fifty jang. If you come any closer, this bastard is as good as dead—”
hunks.sol: “Fifty jang. Stay at least fifty jang away. If you come any closer, this bastard is as good as dead—”

hunks.baseline: It was at that exact moment.
hunks.sol: At that exact moment—

hunks.baseline: Barely three jang away, Jin Taekyung calmly opened his mouth again.
hunks.sol: Barely three jang away, Jin Taekyung calmly spoke again.

hunks.baseline: “I said three. You fucking old bastard. Are you deaf?”
hunks.sol: “I said three, you fucking old bastard. Are you deaf?”
*He’s coming.*

hunks.baseline: He was coming. Those two words sent a chill down Song Il’s spine.
hunks.sol: Those words sent a chill down Song Il’s spine.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh.
hunks.sol: *Whoosh.*

hunks.baseline: A faint sound of wind pierced his ears. A presence was rapidly drawing close from behind him at an unbelievable speed.
hunks.sol: A faint rush of wind pierced his ears. A presence was rapidly closing in from behind at an unbelievable speed.

hunks.baseline: *I am the Roaring Fury Swordsman, Song Il!*
hunks.sol: *I am Song Il, the Roaring Fury Swordsman!*

hunks.baseline: Sssshhhhh!
hunks.sol: *Sssshhhhh!*

hunks.baseline: The Heavenly River Thirty-Six Swords, which he had brought to nine-tenths mastery, erupted. Sword Energy split into twenty-four streams and shot forward.
hunks.sol: The Heavenly River Thirty-Six Swords, which he had brought to nine-tenths mastery, erupted. His Sword Energy split into twenty-four streams and shot forward.

hunks.baseline: Swish, swish, swish, swish, swish!
hunks.sol: *Swish, swish, swish, swish, swish!*

hunks.baseline: He narrowly evaded the twenty-four blades of Sword Energy as they rushed in, covering all twenty-four directions.
hunks.sol: He narrowly evaded the twenty-four streams of Sword Energy as they closed in from every direction.

hunks.baseline: The price he paid for avoiding the Roaring Fury Swordsman’s sword strike was limited to torn clothing and blood dripping here and there.
hunks.sol: The only price he paid for evading the Roaring Fury Swordsman’s strike was torn clothing and scattered drops of blood.

hunks.baseline: Song Il, still in shock, was given no chance to attack again.
hunks.sol: Song Il was given no chance to recover from his shock.

hunks.baseline: Something firm and hot had seized his wrist as he tried to unleash his second form.
hunks.sol: Something firm and hot clamped around his wrist just as he tried to unleash the second form.
*Clench!*

hunks.baseline: His hand clamped down.
Only then did Song Il realize.
hunks.sol: Only then did Song Il realize that he could no longer hear the wind.

hunks.baseline: He could no longer hear the sound of the wind.
And he had touched someone he never should have touched.
hunks.sol: And that he had touched someone he never should have touched.

hunks.baseline: “You—you’re… How could you…”
hunks.sol: “Y-you… How could you…”

hunks.baseline: “The Zhongnan brat has grown a lot. You can’t even recognize an adult anymore.”
hunks.sol: “The Zhongnan brat has certainly grown. You can’t even recognize your elders anymore.”

hunks.baseline: The old monster who had inflicted an unforgettable humiliation on him long ago had come back to life in his memories—and was now standing before him.
hunks.sol: The old monster who had inflicted an unforgettable humiliation upon him long ago had stepped out of his memories and now stood before him.

hunks.baseline: “Fire King—!”
hunks.sol: “Fire King!”

hunks.baseline: The weight carried by that name pressed down upon the entire training ground.
hunks.sol: The weight of that name pressed down upon the entire training ground.

hunks.baseline: They were gods, stars, and kings who stood above the countless martial artists of Murim. Absolute beings who stood closest to the title of the greatest under heaven.
hunks.sol: They were gods, stars, and kings who towered above the countless martial artists of Murim. Absolute beings who stood closest to the title of greatest under heaven.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang was dressed in shabby clothes and had a slight frame, but the presence he gave off was that of a giant itself.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang wore shabby clothes and had a slight frame, but his presence was that of a giant.

hunks.baseline: I never thought that voice could sound so welcome. I sank down on the spot.
hunks.sol: I never thought that voice could sound so welcome. I sank to the ground on the spot.

hunks.baseline: At my soulless reply, Jeok Cheongang glared at me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang glared at my soulless reply.

hunks.baseline: Thinking about it, I had parted with Jeok Cheongang that very morning.
hunks.sol: Come to think of it, I had parted with Jeok Cheongang that very morning.
*Insolent bastard?*

hunks.baseline: *Insolent bastard?* How many people in the world could call the Senior Brother of the Zhongnan Sect’s Sect Leader—and an Elder at that—something like that?
hunks.sol: How many people in the world could call the Senior Brother of the Zhongnan Sect’s Sect Leader—and an Elder at that—something like that?

hunks.baseline: The Roaring Fury Swordsman Song Il was trembling from head to toe.
hunks.sol: Song Il, the Roaring Fury Swordsman, was trembling from head to toe.

hunks.baseline: The Fire King blinked as though he were looking at some fascinating creature, then gave a hollow laugh.
hunks.sol: The Fire King blinked as though he were looking at some fascinating creature, then let out a hollow laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve grown a lot.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve certainly grown.”

hunks.baseline: Smack.
hunks.sol: *Smack.*

hunks.baseline: It was a sight that would have been difficult to see even if you paid for it.
hunks.sol: It was a sight money couldn’t buy.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang slapped the Roaring Fury Swordsman across the face with his wrinkled hand. Though his hand moved infinitely slowly, the Roaring Fury Swordsman couldn’t dare evade it even while watching it approach.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang slapped the Roaring Fury Swordsman across the face with his wrinkled hand. His hand moved so slowly it seemed to take forever, yet the Roaring Fury Swordsman didn’t dare evade it even though he could see it coming.

hunks.baseline: Smack.
hunks.sol: *Smack.*

hunks.baseline: “You were arrogant and rude, causing all kinds of trouble while relying on your sect’s halo. And now you’re an Elder of the Zhongnan Sect?”
hunks.sol: “You were arrogant and rude, causing all kinds of trouble while hiding behind your sect’s prestige. And now you’re an Elder of the Zhongnan Sect?”

hunks.baseline: Smack.
hunks.sol: *Smack.*

hunks.baseline: “Once, I saved you when you were about to die, and the thing you said afterward was unbelievable. Was it, ‘Why are you stealing someone else’s battle credit?’”
hunks.sol: “Once, I saved you when you were about to die, and what you said afterward was truly something. Was it, ‘Why are you stealing someone else’s battle credit?’”

hunks.baseline: Smack.
hunks.sol: *Smack.*

hunks.baseline: Smack, smack, smack!
hunks.sol: *Smack, smack, smack!*

hunks.baseline: The ordinary slaps carried not a trace of internal energy, yet the half-gray-haired Roaring Fury Swordsman shrank like a beaten child.
hunks.sol: The ordinary slaps carried not a trace of internal energy, yet the graying Roaring Fury Swordsman shrank like a beaten child.

hunks.baseline: The eyes that had shone with a powerful man’s confidence and arrogance were now buried beneath humiliation, fury, and fear.
hunks.sol: The ease and arrogance of a powerful man had vanished from his eyes, replaced by humiliation, fury, and fear.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang spat out the words with the expression of a man looking at a bug.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang looked at him as if he were a bug.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung and Hyuk Mujin were already gazing at Jeok Cheongang with eyes full of love.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung and Hyuk Mujin were already gazing at Jeok Cheongang with love in their eyes.

hunks.baseline: “You call yourself an Elder of the Nine Sects and One Gang, yet you threaten commoners and use your power to arbitrarily order a sect to seal its gates? If your Master saw this, he would be wailing in the afterlife.”
hunks.sol: “You call yourself an Elder of the Nine Sects and One Gang, yet you threaten commoners and throw your weight around, ordering a family to seal its gates as you please? If your Master saw this, he would be wailing in the afterlife.”

hunks.baseline: “Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord? I’ve never heard of such a title in my life. Is that why a piece of trash like you struts around calling yourself an Elder of the Zhongnan Sect?”
hunks.sol: “Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord? I’ve never heard that title in my life. Is that why a piece of trash like you struts around calling himself an Elder of the Zhongnan Sect?”

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t enough that his sect had been insulted. The Roaring Fury Swordsman had suddenly been reduced to a piece of trash, and his face twisted violently.
hunks.sol: As if having his sect insulted weren’t enough, the Roaring Fury Swordsman had suddenly been reduced to a piece of trash. His face twisted violently.

hunks.baseline: When he silently lowered his head to hide his humiliation and anger, Jeok Cheongang widened his tiger-like eyes.
hunks.sol: When he silently lowered his head to hide his humiliation and anger, Jeok Cheongang’s tiger-like eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: “…Great Hero Jeok. I—I merely…”
hunks.sol: “…Great Hero Jeok. I-I merely…”

hunks.baseline: At this very moment, the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, was no different from an idol—the undisputed star of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
hunks.sol: At this very moment, the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, was practically the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s idol.

hunks.baseline: *Is this what it feels like to bathe in a hot spring of soda?*
hunks.sol: *Is this what it feels like to bathe in a hot spring filled with soda?*

hunks.baseline: Even my white blood cells were fizzing.
hunks.sol: Even my white blood cells seemed to fizz with carbonation.

hunks.baseline: It felt like chugging an ice-cold can of beer after a raid on a sweltering summer day.
hunks.sol: It felt like chugging a can of beer so cold it had begun to ice over after finishing a raid on a sweltering summer day.

hunks.baseline: A three-layer wave of refreshing exhilaration swept over my entire body.
hunks.sol: Wave after wave of exhilarating refreshment swept through my entire body.

hunks.baseline: “I’m saying that this is not something for Great Hero Jeok to involve himself in.”
hunks.sol: “I’m saying that this is not a matter for Great Hero Jeok to involve himself in.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang stared blankly at the Roaring Fury Swordsman, who had finished speaking in a trembling voice.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang studied the Roaring Fury Swordsman, who had forced out those words in a trembling voice.

hunks.baseline: His tightly clenched fist twitched, as if he were considering where to hit him so people would say he had chosen the perfect spot.
hunks.sol: His tightly clenched fist twitched as if he were deciding where to hit him so everyone would agree he had chosen the perfect spot.

hunks.baseline: Then, the next moment, his wrinkled finger was pointing at me.
hunks.sol: Then, the next moment, his wrinkled finger pointed at me.

hunks.baseline: Just as everyone’s faces, mine included, filled with confusion, the Fire King continued.
hunks.sol: Just as confusion spread across every face, mine included, the Fire King continued.

hunks.sol: Silence descended upon the Grand Training Ground.
